verdict.rationale: Windmill exposes a CLI (wmill), webhooks, and various trigger mechanisms (HTTP routes, schedules, MCP) that let external systems and AI agents drive it (windmill-docs-9, windmill-docs-15, windmill-docs-16, windmill-docs-17, windmill-probe-4, windmill-probe-5), which is real evidence of programmatic/agentic control. However, a direct probe for a documented public REST/OpenAPI spec (the canonical 'documented public API') returned 404 on all candidate paths (windmill-probe-3), so no first-class API reference doc was found in evidence. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/REST API reference page, independent confirmation that third parties integrate via a general public API beyond webhooks/CLI/MCP.
